briefdescription.para: Constructor: initializes the handler with default recovery strategies.
Handle invalid adapter reference in graph.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-01): Caller references an adapter key that does not exist in the graph. This is a common failure when adapters are removed or the graph becomes stale.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_ADAPTER_NOT_FOUND (9531)
Recovery: Fail-closed with clear error indication. Caller must verify adapter exists before calling graph methods.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9531 and fail-closed recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-02): Caller requests top-k results where k > graph size. Requesting top-1000 adapters when graph has only 50 adapters.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_INDEX_LOOKUP_FAILED (9521)
Recovery: Graceful degradation. Return top-min(k, size) results.

parameterdescription.para: Actual number of adapters in graph.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-03): Fingerprint entry has NaN, Inf, or invalid norm. This indicates data corruption or computation failure upstream.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_GRAPH_INVALID_SELF_IP (9510)
Recovery: Fail-closed with data corruption indication. Requires fingerprint recomputation or graph reconstruction.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9510 and fail-closed recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-04): Computing adapter's similarity to itself should yield 1.0, but computation fails or returns invalid value.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_GRAPH_INVALID_SELF_IP (9510)
Recovery: Retry with validation, then fail-closed if persistent.

parameterdescription.para: The adapter being compared to itself.

simplesect.para: Result with error code and retry/fail-closed recovery.

memberdef.name: handleNullTrainComparison

briefdescription.para: Handle cross-adapter comparison with null/empty trains.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-05): Attempting to compare adapters where one or both have empty or null TT-train representations.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_GRAPH_OTHER_TRAIN_NOT_FOUND (9513)
Recovery: Fail-closed. Trains must be non-empty for comparison.

parameterdescription.para: Which adapter has null/empty train (if known).

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9513 and fail-closed recovery.

briefdescription.para: Handle concurrent modification detected during traversal.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-06): Graph structure changes during an ongoing query (adapter added/removed while findSimilar is executing).
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION (9570)
Recovery: Retry with full read-lock, or fail-closed if contention high.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9570 and retry/fail-closed recovery.

briefdescription.para: Handle bridge routing failures under load.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-07): Ingestion bridge cannot route request to appropriate decomposer (queue full, all decomposers busy).
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_INDEX_ROUTING_FAILED (9522)
Recovery: Retry with exponential backoff, or queue for later.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9522 and retry recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-08): Adapter service is unreachable, network timeout, or connection drop during decomposition request.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_ADAPTER_COMMUNICATION_ERROR (9532)
Recovery: Retry with backoff, or fallback to cached/degraded results.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9532 and retry/fallback recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-09): Bridge receives decomposition result with invalid data: rank overflow, NaN in cores, dimension mismatch.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_FINGERPRINT_COMPUTATION_FAILED (9540)
Recovery: Reject result, retry decomposition with different params.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9540 and retry recovery.

memberdef.argsstring: (std::size_t embedding_dim, double estimated_kappa, double min_kappa) noexcept
memberdef.name: handleKappaGateViolation

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-10): κ-gate (kappa gate) estimates that compression won't achieve min_kappa threshold, but caller ignores and forces decompose.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_FINGERPRINT_COMPUTATION_FAILED (9540)
Recovery: Graceful degradation or fail-closed based on policy.

simplesect.para: Result with error code and degrade/fail-closed recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-11): Serializing graph to file/buffer fails: I/O error, permission denied, or serializer exception.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_PERSISTENCE_FAILED (9561)
Recovery: Retry with different path, or fail-closed.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9561 and retry/fail-closed recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-12): Replaying graph from persisted state, but fingerprint data is corrupted: deserialization fails, checksums mismatch.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_PERSISTENCE_FAILED (9561)
Recovery: Skip corrupt entry, or abort replay with full rebuild.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9561 and skip/rebuild recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-13): Detecting that graph persistence is incomplete: some entries missing, or state file truncated/partial.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_PERSISTENCE_FAILED (9561)
Recovery: Partial recovery (load what's available) with warning, or full reconstruction from source.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9561 and degrade/rebuild recovery.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-14): Allocating fingerprint structures, TT-cores, or temporary buffers fails due to insufficient memory.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_FINGERPRINT_COMPUTATION_FAILED (9540)
Recovery: Fail-closed with memory exhaustion indication. Requires freeing memory or rejecting new requests.

parameterdescription.para: Bytes that could not be allocated.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9540 and fail-closed recovery.

memberdef.name: handleConcurrentMemoryExhaustion

briefdescription.para: Handle memory exhaustion under concurrent access.

detaileddescription.para: Scenario (TEDGE-15): During high concurrency (many threads accessing graph), memory growth becomes unbounded or exceeds limit.
Error Code: ERR_TENSOR_LOCK_ACQUISITION_FAILED (9571)
Recovery: Throttle new requests, trigger cleanup, or fail-closed.

simplesect.para: Result with error code 9571 and throttle/fail-closed recovery.

Centralized handler for deterministic edge case scenarios.

detaileddescription.para: This class manages all edge case scenarios for the tensor module, ensuring deterministic behavior, explicit error codes, and well-defined recovery paths.
